name: junkd
description: Handoff, orch, tldr, ctx-limit, ctx-tokens and the status line in one plugin: save and resume durable task context, drain a backlog with implementation and independent verification subagents, score the code against the spec files, summarize or keep replies terse, guard and read the context size. The /junkd pane, the tools pane, the automatic handoff loop, the main-loop guard and the status line are Claude Code mods or settings and do nothing here.

interface.shortDescription: Handoffs, the orch loop, TL;DR and a context guard in one plugin
interface.longDescription: Writes durable Markdown handoffs and restores them by short id, runs a resumable task loop with isolated worktrees and evidence gates, and summarizes or keeps replies terse, and warns or stops near a configured context threshold. The /junkd pane, the automatic handoff loop and the status line are Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Save a handoff for this task.
Process the next eligible task with orch.
Summarize my latest request in three sentences.
